name: ibis Styles Copenhagen Orestad
desc: ibis Styles Copenhagen Ørestad is located in the vibrant Amager Island district, surrounded by nature parks, wetlands, and forests. The hotel features a contemporary, homely design blending natural elements with urban flair. Enjoy on-site parking, a quiet work zone, and a stylish bar and restaurant. Copenhagen city centre and the airport are easily accessible, with Bella Sky Metro Station just a short walk away.

name: 25hours Hotel Copenhagen Paper Island
desc: Just steps from Nyhavn, 25hours Hotel Paper Island is a peaceful retreat in the heart of Copenhagen. Located on Christiansholm, the former Paper Island, the hotel draws inspiration from the simplicity and comfort of a Scandinavian island getaway. Designed by Swedish creative team STYLT Trampoli, its spaces evoke warm memories, relaxed moments and a sense of escape, while remaining connected to the energy of the city.

name: 25hours Hotel Indre By
desc: Right in the heart of Copenhagen, 25hours Hotel Indre By places guests between the iconic Round Tower and lively Købmagergade. Its 243 rooms, ranging from Small to Gigantic, offer a unique retreat for every type of traveler.
